title: Fire, storm or flood damages the property
summary: Make the site safe, notify the insurer and lender, document the loss and communicate with tenants and investors.

situation.trigger: A fire, storm or flood damages the building or makes space unusable.

outlineSteps: Make sure everyone is safe and call emergency services if needed
Secure the site and stop further damage
Photograph and document the damage before cleanup
Notify the insurer and open a claim
Notify the lender as the loan requires
Read each lease's casualty clause for abatement, rebuild and termination rights
Hire mitigation contractors and keep every receipt
Get repair estimates and work with the adjuster
Re-test cash flow and loan coverage with abated rent
Calendar the lease and loan restoration deadlines
Tell tenants and investors what the leases and loan provide
Record the claim, payments and repairs in the property file
